name: personal-workbench
description: 个人学习与成长工作台的网页与 Android APK 包装工程

scripts.ingest:refs: node scripts/ingest-reference-banks.mjs && python scripts/assign-bank-levels.py && python scripts/build-literacy-data.py && python scripts/build-preschool-banks.py
scripts.assign:bank-levels: python scripts/assign-bank-levels.py && python scripts/build-literacy-data.py && python scripts/build-preschool-banks.py
scripts.android:init: npm run android:prepare && cap add android
scripts.android:sync: npm run android:prepare && cap sync android
scripts.android:build: npm run android:sync && node scripts/stamp-android-release.mjs && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleRelease
